static_traits.name: Chen Huilan
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends, but has not yet fully shared feelings of inadequacy with friends
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;no history of treatment for psychological issues
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, with self-Reflection and cooperativeness; able to describe trigger situations and automatic thoughts concretely; evident cognitive biases including mind-reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization, and personalization

basic_info.main_problem: I believe potential partners will not be interested in me, because I do not think I am good-looking enough. This sense of inadequacy worsened after the breakup, stronger when Seeing happy couples, affecting self-esteem, socializing, as well as sleep and diet.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of inadequacy are affecting my self-esteem and hindering my social interactions.
growth_experiences: Experienced the end of a relationship (breakup) about a year ago. Stress was very high at the time, and feelings of inadequacy have gradually intensified since; especially evident when Seeing happy couples or socializing with partnered friends. Despite support from friends and colleagues, she tends to interpret others' approval as politeness rather than sincerity, gradually affecting sleep and diet rhythms, though Work performance is basically not yet affected.

core_beliefs: I am not worth being chosen / being loved

special_situations.event: Socializing with partnered friends or Seeing happy couples
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not good-looking, no one will choose me; everyone is paired up, meaning I am doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing involvement in romance-related topics and situations, avoiding dating opportunities, keeping silent in order to avoid being compared
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never have such a relationship; no one will want me

special_situations.event: Thinking about dating again or facing romance-related topics
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I try dating, I will Be rejected or humiliated; once young, beautiful people appear, I have no chance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Withdrawal, finding excuses not to attend dating or meet-new-people occasions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why would anyone choose me? There are so many prettier, younger people out there

special_situations.event: Receives positive feedback from friends or colleagues, or is noticed or praised
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are nice to me, it is only out of politeness, not sincerity
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or downplaying positive feedback, Displacing topics to avoid deep engagement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite and courteous, not truly appreciating me

special_situations.event: Recalling breakup experiences, repeatedly pondering self-worth when Being alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one relationship fails, it proves I will fail in all intimate relationships
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Judging oneself by all-or-nothing standards, reinforcing Self-protection to lower the chance of being hurt again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited for intimate relationships; I am doomed to fail again

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be genuinely appreciated and chosen, to build a stable and intimate partner relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fear of Being rejected, being humiliated and being negated again (especially because of appearance)
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected by staying distant and avoiding dating
Interpreting others' positive feedback as politeness to reduce uncertainty and vulnerability

object_relations.self_representation: A 'loser' not attractive enough, easily picked on and rejected
object_relations.object_representation: A picky judge / potential partner who only looks at appearance and could reject oneself at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor raises the exploration that 'friends' positive reactions may be genuine' or suggests conducting a behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing the inner experience of 'not being liked / not being worthy' to others' motives, believing they act only out of politeness (a transference-style negative assumption about others' motives)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a cautious tone, repeatedly use words like 'maybe, perhaps, just politeness', downplaying the other's positivity, avoiding acknowledging the possibility of being appreciated.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing breakup and self-worth, needs to touch feelings of shame and vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Replacing direct experience of one's own emotions with analysis of others' motives and Average patterns, distancing from shame and the sense of Being rejected
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use objectified, abstract language to state experiences, reducing emotional vocabulary and self-feeling descriptions.

manifestations: Reinforced Sense of isolation after the breakup when Seeing happy couples or spending time with partnered friends
Avoiding dating and intimate-relationship attempts out of Fear of Being rejected
Interprets others' kindness as politeness, thereby weakening the possibility of real connection
outcomes: Impaired self-esteem, persistent feelings of inadequacy
Social avoidance and Withdrawal from intimate relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interprets friends' appreciation and laughter as 'just politeness'
Assuming potential partners will negate oneself because of appearance, not yet reality-tested

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial: believing 'inferior to younger, prettier people'
Strongly worries about failure when attempting behavioral experiments, observes cautiously to avoid being hurt

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not fully expressing feelings of inadequacy and real needs to friends, choosing to digest alone
Reducing participation in romance-related socializing, Repressing the urge to reach out

exception_events.target_problem: In social situations with friends, the client typically believes others have no real interest in her, thus expressing and participating less.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once, at a gathering with friends, she proactively shared a story about a bizarre dream; the friends laughed on the spot and showed interest, and the interaction atmosphere was relaxed and positive.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: proactively sharing personal experiences; different support: within a supportive friend group; different understanding: focusing more on in-the-moment reactions than Self-denial.

positive_force: Stable career and Work functioning not yet visibly affected
There is a supportive network of friends; has realistic support resources
Willing to try reality testing and behavioral experiments, has motivation to change
Can briefly improve self-feeling through hobbies and self-care
negative_force: Negative core beliefs about appearance and self-worth are deeply rooted
Common cognitive distortions: mind-reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization, and negating the positive
Avoidance and Withdrawal in intimate-relationship situations maintain Loneliness and low self-esteem
Attributes positive feedback to 'politeness', weakening the integration of positive experiences

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance and Withdrawal in topics or scenarios involving dating / intimate relationships
antecedent: Socializing with partnered friends or Seeing happy couples
Thinking of dating again or being invited to romance-related activities
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core beliefs (I am not attractive enough / not worth being chosen) and catastrophic prediction (will surely Be rejected, humiliated)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential rejection and shame, lowering Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Limiting social and intimate opportunities, reinforcing Loneliness and low self-esteem, Sleep and eating rhythms disturbed

target_behavior.behavior: Negating positive feedback (Interpreting others' appreciation / positive reactions as 'politeness')
antecedent: Receives friends' laughter, attention, or praise in socializing
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading and negative bias about self-worth, avoiding the uncertainty and vulnerability that acknowledging being appreciated would bring
target_behavior.function: Maintains a psychological sense of control and avoids disappointed expectations
target_behavior.consequence: Weakens the integration of positive experiences, maintains the negative self-schema and avoidance behavior
